jobs.BrazilNote: In Brazil, advertising of prescription-only medicines on the internet must be accessible exclusively to professionals authorised to prescribe or dispense them, through an electronic registration system (RDC 96/2008), and ANVISA restated in November 2024 that advertising compounded products to the public is not permitted.
